decisions.reason: Building on the established offer, it likely meets aspirations, so problemistic search is unlikely and slack absorbs uncertainty.
Close to established capabilities and customer base, it should perform near aspirations, making drop unlikely.
Distant from the established offer, it may fall short of aspirations, but slack and still-uncertain results support keeping it for now.
A product line with several models signals commitment and likely acceptable performance relative to aspirations, reducing drop probability.
